curator_note: Zhu is a real name with a moody, synthy house sound, and $70+ buys you a headliner-only night at a new-ish room. Go for the set, not for discovery.
description: Zhu headlines the opening party at Reframe Studios Indoors, presented by Framework, 10pm-3am.

curator_note: Mid-week Los Globos bounce-and-trance bill from Techno Agency; I couldn't verify any of these names, so it's a cheap late-night punt rather than a destination.
description: Techno Agency's Boost night at Los Globos with Cazi, CJ, Miko and Kingping, 11pm-3am.

artist_notes.name: Matt Egbert
artist_notes.note: LA deep-house producer and Front Left Recordings/Productions founder (events in LA, San Diego, NYC, Miami) — multiple Beatport #1 deep-house releases; galactic synths, twisted vocals, groove-forward.

curator_note: Thanksgiving-night deep house and minimal for about $8 is a hard price to argue with. Egbert is the local deep-house name here, and the venue is still TBA via Instagram.
description: Recollect Underground's Thanksgiving night of deep house, deep tech and minimal at a TBA LA location, with Matt Egbert and ARISA.

curator_note: Billed with just a first name and no lineup, so there's little to go on. Sound is a dependable house room, but check who is actually playing before you commit $31.
description: House night titled 'Alisha' at Sound Nightclub in Hollywood, 10pm-2:30am, $31. No lineup listed.

curator_note: Not house, but a TBA DTLA warehouse with a dub siren sound system is its own kind of bass-weight night. Five billed selectors makes it a proper session; the fourth in a series, so it's a recurring thing.
description: Fourth Rub-A-Dub Dance, a dub reggae sound-system night at a TBA DTLA warehouse with General Jah Mikey, General Zooz, Mello Banton, Ryo Vibes and Dub Siren HiFi.

curator_note: Free-with-RSVP Saturday of tech and afro house at Utopia with a secret guest on top. Low stakes and decent for a late drop-in, but I couldn't verify the names so don't expect a destination night.
description: Tech-house and afro-house club night at Utopia with Kimonos, RCKSLVR and Vesper plus a secret guest, starting 11pm on 11/21.

curator_note: Minimal and dub techno from 8pm to 6am at a still-secret DTLA spot is the right shape of night, and it's cheap. I couldn't verify heelbite316 or SCAN D, so it's a bet on the promoters.
description: Off Record and 14th Door present heelbite316 and SCAN D, a minimal and dub techno night running 8pm-6am at a TBA DTLA location.
